alt: Man standing at a Walmart electric vehicle charging station in an outdoor parking lot, no overhead canopy or weather protection visible
story: On August 10, 2026, a viral clip of a man charging his EV at Walmart sparked widespread 'why can't we build chargers with covers?' complaints — Walmart's outdoor charging stations have no overhead canopy, unlike every gas station built in the last century, leaving EV drivers exposed to sun, rain, and snow.
why_funny: The future of transportation promises to be frictionless, yet the reality is standing in the rain next to a pole in a Walmart lot wondering why 1940s gas station designers managed to figure out canopies.
